text:
jess_marketing: Hey team — need a small design burst for next week's benchmark webinar. Deliverables: 3 hero tiles + 1 benchmark explainer diagram. Sizes: 1200x628 (social), 1920x1080 (slides), 600x315 (blog). Diagram should be a clean single-column explainer visualizing latency vs cost tradeoffs with callouts for p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. Brand compliance required. Timeline: first drafts by Wed EOD. Figma link + raw CSV in the drive. @mike_design @brand_bot — can you confirm?

mike_design: Ack. Please drop the figma link and the copy for each tile (headline + 1-liner). Are we OK to reuse the sparkline SVGs from the bench-kit or do you want fresh ones? Also: prefer light or dark hero?

jess_marketing: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/benchmark-webinar-assets (view only for now). Copy roughs: Tile A headline "Latency-first inference" / line "High throughput, low p50 for user-facing flows"; Tile B headline "Cost-optimized serving" / line "Reduce per-token cost with batching and caching"; Tile C headline "Predictable SLAs" / line "Dedicated pools for consistent latency". Use fresh sparklines if easy — variations that show p50 vs cost. Light theme for social, slides can be dark variant.

olivia_prod: Adding data notes — use p50 = 45ms, p95 = 210ms, cost examples: $0.12 per 1k tokens (hosted) vs $0.04 per 1k tokens (dedicated avg). For the diagram, highlight the knee where batching helps but adds ~20ms. Label axes: x="Latency (ms)" y="Cost per 1k tokens ($)". Callouts: "Batching benefit", "KV cache savings".

mike_design: Nice — that helps. Two quick Qs: (1) Can we swap the order of tiles for the landing hero? (2) Any mandatory legal copy for the slide footer?

jess_marketing: (1) Yes, landing hero order should be Cost -> Latency -> SLA. (2) Legal: "Benchmarks are representative; your mileage may vary. See docs." — please include in 10pt footer.

brand_bot: Brand compliance check: use logo lockup v2 (horizontal), primary palette #0A2C4A / #1DA1F2 accents, font = Inter variable. Do not use secondary gradient used in past campaigns. Approved CTA styles: rounded 6px, microcopy 12px. See brand guide: https://redwood.brand/guide.

mike_design: Copying color hexes into the file. Quick mock plan: I’ll produce 2 variants per size (light/dark) + a focused explainer slide for the diagram. Will post Figma comps by Tue AM, full first pass Wed EOD. Any animation needed?

jess_marketing: No animations for launch assets — maybe a 3-frame GIF for social later but not required for initial drop.

syd_research: Small copy suggestion for the diagram caption to keep legal-safe language: "Representative inference economics comparing hosted and dedicated serving across typical production workloads." Also avoid naming model checkpoints; use "open models" / "Redwood-verified models" phrasing.

mike_design: Got the caption note. I’ll keep product copy generic. One design ask: can we include an inset showing sample token counts for common workflows (chat: 600 tokens, summarize: 120 tokens)? It helps contextualize costs.

jess_marketing: Yes include that inset — use 3 micro-examples only. Keep them compact.

mike_design: Cool. Uploading a quick wireframe now — will ping when ready.

(attachment: figma-wireframe-screenshot.png)

jess_marketing: Saw the wireframe — looks good. Thanks all. I’ll review Tue and leave consolidated comments in Figma. :thumbsup: 

brand_bot: Reminder: request a brand QA pass once final comps are uploaded (tag @brand_bot to trigger automated check).

mike_design: Will do.

jess_marketing: Final timeline recap: Tue AM — first Figma comps, Wed EOD — design first pass handed off for content and brand QA, Thu — revisions and final export. If anything slips, notify here.

olivia_prod: Noted. I’ll prepare the final CSV with chart points and drop in the drive by EOD today.

syd_research: Happy to review copy after first pass.

mike_design: Uploaded initial comps at 1760001400. Figured two colorways, included inset and diagram sketch. @jess_marketing @brand_bot please review.

jess_marketing: Reviewing now. Small tweak: swap CTA color to accent blue on social variant.

mike_design: Updated and reposted v2 at 1760001475.

jess_marketing: Perfect — thanks team. Will leave final comments and request brand QA once Olivia's CSV is in. :rocket:
